title: answer body (sealed)
description: The answer to a question. Ends the exchange. `by` says who answered: the Obi by itself, from what its owner let it tell, or its owner in their own words (spec/protocol.md, 'answer'). Sealed: derived from actions/answer.schema.json by spec/conformance/generate.mjs, every x-obi-text field a sealed_text (spec/protocol.md section 9.1). Don't edit it by hand.

by.description: obi: the receiving Obi answered by itself, from what a sharing rule of its owner allows. owner: its owner wrote the answer.

choice.description: The index of the choice picked, when the question had choices.

by_rule.description: The one sharing rule of its owner the Obi answered under. Only with by: obi.
